name: com.lingkyn.xr-ui-shell.ugui
description: Thin UGUI sibling adapter for the Lingkyn XR UI Shell Core: fail-closed binding of each declared panel to exactly one world-space Canvas subtree with an event camera, a raycaster, and (for a wrist- or hand-admitting panel) an anchor transform, each an explicit reference with a stable diagnostic when missing; one injectable ScriptableObject skin seam mapping the shared design-language tokens to the closed shell-slot set with a default skin carrying the canonical values; translation of accepted routing results to the bound Canvas only; a plain runtime constructed with explicit references that applies accepted placement intents to the bound Canvas subtrees; and, as one client of the shell, a small ITuningPanelSurface-compatible adapter for the Live Tuning panel host.
